## `PreviewAttribute` { #previewattribute-sealed-class }

`public sealed class PreviewAttribute : Attribute`

Marks a design-time preview, rendered by the IDE without running the app (Visual Studio "XenoUI Preview" tool window). Apply it to a static, parameterless method returning `XenoComponent`, or to a `XenoPage` with a parameterless constructor. Repeat it to preview the same UI on several devices or directions.

Previews are composed in isolation: there is no `XenoApp`, navigation, native capability or network. Keep them pure and feed them sample data. The attribute has no effect at runtime.

**Constructors**

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `PreviewAttribute()` |  |
| `PreviewAttribute(string name)` |  |

**Properties**

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `Type App { get; set; }` | The `XenoApp` class a page preview is attached to. Only needed when the assembly declares several apps; by default the single app of the page's assembly is constructed (never started) and `OnPreview` is called. |
| `bool RightToLeft { get; set; }` | Lays the preview out right-to-left. |
| `float Height { get; set; }` | Logical height override, in dp. 0 keeps the device height, or wraps a component. |
| `float Width { get; set; }` | Logical width override, in dp. 0 keeps the device width. |
| `string Device { get; set; }` | Device frame: `android`, `pixel`, `iphone`, `iphone-se`, `foldable` or `tablet`. Methods default to a component preview (device width, content height); pages default to `android`. |
| `string Group { get; set; }` | Optional group, to filter related previews. |
| `string Name { get; set; }` | Caption shown above the preview; defaults to the member name. |
| `uint Background { get; set; }` | ARGB color painted behind the preview. |

## `PreviewRenderer` { #previewrenderer-static-class }

`public static class PreviewRenderer`

Headless design-time renderer: composes one preview into a private engine and encodes a PNG. The application is never run: a page preview is attached to its app object constructed but not started (see `IsPreview`), with stand-in native services; no window, device or native host is involved.

**Methods**

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `static IReadOnlyList<PreviewEntry> Discover(Type type)` | Previews declared directly on `type` and its methods, in source order. |
| `static PreviewImage Render(Func<XenoComponent> content, PreviewAttribute spec = null, Assembly assets = null, float scale = 2)` | Renders a component built by `content` with the given frame. |
| `static PreviewImage Render(PreviewEntry entry, Assembly assets = null, float scale = 2)` | Renders a discovered preview. Never throws for developer-code failures. |
